query: SELECT f.empresaSlug, f.data, f.cat5 FROM faturamentos f WHERE f.data LIKE '2026-03%' AND f.empresaSlug IN ('MORUMBI', 'MASCOTE') ORDER BY f.empresaSlug, f.data DESC LIMIT 10;
